findings.problem: Response shapes use snake_case relation keys (city_info, state_info, modality_info, pricing_rules, schedule_configs) while Court relation methods are camelCase; correct because Eloquent $snakeAttributes defaults true, but the mechanism is undocumented and an implementer might wrongly rename the relations.
findings.fix: Add one doc line: relation keys are snake_cased by Eloquent's default $snakeAttributes=true, so pricingRules serializes as pricing_rules (same as Team::cityInfo -> city_info).

findings.where: Future tables / Phase 3 note; API surface court/show
findings.problem: court/show/{id} is owner-scoped (403 if not owner); phase 3 public detail will need a separate non-owner endpoint, but the design does not state court/show is NOT reused publicly.
findings.fix: In Phase 3 note add: the public detail endpoint is new in phase 3; court/show/{id} stays owner-scoped and is not reused publicly.

findings.problem: The slot-fit rule (end-start >= duration) is stated unconditionally, but an inactive weekday (isActive=false, court closed) may legitimately have blank/nonsensical window fields.
findings.fix: Clarify: when isActive=true, startTime/endTime/reservationDuration are required and end-start >= duration; when isActive=false, those fields are nullable and the slot-fit check is skipped.

findings.problem: Phase 1 does not validate that pricing rules cover the schedule window, so a phase-2 slot could match no pricing rule and have a null price; acceptable but undocumented.
findings.fix: Add doc note: phase 2 must handle slots with no matching pricing rule (reject booking or require full coverage); phase 1 does not enforce coverage because pricing rules are optional on create.
